review_improvement: Converts an overly broad scan into a complete exact-ID per-BDF negotiated-link audit with error context.
independent_technical_reasoning: LnkCap states what a port can support, while LnkSta states what it actually negotiated; a capable Gen5 x16 port may currently run narrower or slower. Because repeated output lines lack identity after a bare grep, BDF association and expected-count completeness are essential to prove every intended bridge meets 32GT/s x16.
